fusions.name: Crushing Edict
fusions.desc: Brings overwhelming force down on one enemy, dealing 34 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Spent Vigour
fusions.desc: Pays 5% of your maximum health to release a burst of force that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Gathered Will
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to gather, then increases your damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Casting Weight
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
